slides.h1: Same Sun Sign. Completely Different Career Outcomes.
slides.sub: Two illustrative people, one Sun sign, two D-10 stories.

slides.body: Two people share a Sun sign. A sun-sign column gives both the same career advice. This is a made-up example, not named individuals.
D-10 (Dashamsa, the career divisional chart) shows a strong 10th lord, well placed. Their running dasha (planetary period) links to the 10th house. Career builds steadily.
Same Sun sign, but the D-10 10th lord is weak and the dasha lord sits away from career houses. Progress is slower, with a different work style.
It checks one placement. Dasha, D-10 and house strength change the outcome. Combining them gives different, specific guidance for each.
